Article: Moscow (CNN)Russian President Vladimir Putin appeared in a series of photos released by the Kremlin on Friday after a week in which canceled engagements led to speculation over his health. The three images showed Putin meeting with the head of the Supreme Court in Moscow on Friday, the Kremlin said.

Summary: Kremlin releases images of a meeting it says President Vladimir Putin held Friday .
Putin spokesman dismisses rumors of ill health sparked by Putin's cancellation of planned talks .
